title: File:Diagram showing liver lesioning using a HIFU transducer.png
desc: A schematic diagram showing the basic principle of extra-corporeal HIFU for treatment of a soft tissue tumour in the liver. The focal region can be placed at depth within a tumour, where a series of adjacent ‘lesions’ known as a lesion array can be formed as shown.
